tasks.title: Conversation #58
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hey Linda. I've been looking all over for you.
Woman: I just got back from lunch, what's up?
Man: I've been thinking about getting a new couch for my dorm room Do you have any recommendations?
Woman: Have you checked out Comfort Furniture Store? I shop there all the time. They have a great selection and their prices are.
Man: Do you know if they offer delivery services?
Woman: Yes, they do, and they're having a sale starting tomorrow. I'll send you a link to their catalogue.

questions.stem: Why was the man looking for the woman?

options.A: To ask her for help studying
options.B: To deliver a piece of furniture to her
options.D: To get details on an upcoming sale

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士为什么要找女士？ 定位原文：Man: I've been thinking about getting a new couch for my dorm room. Do you have any recommendations? 选项分析： A. To ask her for help studying 请她帮忙学习。因为对话中未提及学习相关的内容，所以 A选项错误。 B. To deliver a piece of furniture to her 给她送一件家具。因为男士是想买家具，而不是送家具，所以 B 选项错误。 C. To seek a recommendation 寻求推荐。由于男士明确表示正在考虑买新沙发，并询问女士是否有推荐，所以 C 选项正确。 D. To get details on an upcoming sale 获取即将举行的促销活动的详细信息。因为男士是在询问家具推荐，关于促销的信息是女士随后补充的，并非男士寻找她的初衷，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do next?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士接下来最有可能做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: I'll send you a link to their catalogue. 选项分析： A. Pay for a delivery 支付送货费。因为对话中未提及女士需要支付费用，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Look at a map 看地图。因为对话中未提及地图，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Give the man some information 给男士一些信息。由于女士承诺发送家具店的目录链接，这属于提供信息，所以 C 选项正确。 D. Go to a store 去商店。因为女士说会发链接，而不是现在去商店，所以 D 选项错误。
